surface_mechanism_description: The ALE process allows the absorbed species (Ga, In, or N) to migrate at the growing surface with higher surface diffusion as compared to bulk growth techniques such as MOCVD or MBE. NH3 is cracked on a more active surface, a surface covered with Ga and In adatoms or their monomethyl-metal radicals.
